title: Multi-encounter real-TLE zero-burn baseline validation

sample_selection.rule_fixed_before_zero_burn_comparisons: Include the Phase 12.4 valid event. Exclude its source archive from additional sampling; scan remaining saved screening-job export filenames lexicographically and each archive valid event IDs lexicographically. Select the first event for each new unordered object-ID pair with both original source-attributed TLE line pairs present; stop at five total encounters. Selection uses no TCA/miss deltas, Pc, maneuver output, or agreement measure.
sample_selection.selection_limits: Deterministic convenience sample, not random or representative. Four additions are from one 24-hour catalog snapshot; source groups overlap.

screening_implementation.time_scale: UTC converted to split Julian date; no TEME transform
screening_implementation.refinement: bounded subdivisions and golden-section TCA refinement; exact convergence details retained per event
screening_implementation.ai_safety: Before each of five screen_tle_records calls, the report-generation code asserted predict_from_physics, predict_orbital_anomaly, and compare_ml_and_physics were replaced. Regressions assert stub calls occurred.

maneuver_implementation.call: lead_seconds=300, burn_magnitudes_m_s=(0.01,); solver includes a separate zero-delta-v candidate
maneuver_implementation.propagation: Earth two-body point-mass RK4, mu=398600.4418 km^3/s^2
maneuver_implementation.search: burn epoch through 1800 s after event TCA; 5 s grid with local refinement to 0.01 s
maneuver_implementation.interpretation: zero-burn is a simulated baseline distinct from the SGP4 event; candidates are not operational recommendations.

cause_investigation.verified: For all five sampled encounters, zero-burn closest approach is at the replay TCA to solver precision and miss-distance differences are at floating-point scale. The maneuver search grid explicitly contains event TCA (elapsed=lead_seconds); the solver back-propagates TCA states to the burn epoch and forward-propagates them with the same two-body model.
cause_investigation.stored_vs_replay: Stored event to current replay differences are small but nonzero and are preserved per case. No causal explanation is established; time conversion, historic code/runtime or refinement details are possibilities, not proven causes.
cause_investigation.model_difference: SGP4/SDP4 and two-body are different propagation models. This five-case sample cannot establish general equivalence.

report_independent_checks.method: Python JSON structural checks plus recomputation from saved source exports and report fields; no screening or inference calls in this check.
report_independent_checks.result: JSON parsed; exactly five unique unordered pairs including Phase 12.4 encounter; 5/5 source archive SHA-256 hashes; 10/10 exact TLE line-pair SHA-256 hashes; 5/5 stored-to-replay TCA and miss differences recomputed; 5/5 replay-to-zero-burn miss differences recomputed; 5/5 hook-use and repeatability assertions present; all five comparison_status values available.
report_independent_checks.limits: Recorded replay and two-body numerical results were independently cross-checked against the report arithmetic and deterministic fixture regression. Historical source exports are the provenance source; CelesTrak was not contacted.

orbit_refinement_failure_investigation.observed: minimize_relative_distance returns invalid, reason_code non_unique_tca_flat_distance, miss_distance_km 0.0, offset_seconds None for identical states throughout [0, 30] s.
orbit_refinement_failure_investigation.contract: The solver detects a flat distance interval and intentionally withholds TCA because infinitely many epochs share the same minimum. It preserves the known zero miss distance. The solver implementation is consistent with the non-unique-TCA contract; the old test expectation of valid or boundary was incorrect.
orbit_refinement_failure_investigation.change: Renamed and corrected the test to assert invalid/non_unique_tca_flat_distance, zero miss distance, and no TCA. Existing non-finite-state and invalid-propagation tests continue to reject unrelated invalid cases.
orbit_refinement_failure_investigation.verification: Corrected test passes; all 12 TcaReferenceTests and all 34 trajectory-screening tests pass.

limitations: Historical source exports were marked partial overall; every selected source event and two-track replay was valid.
Recorded CelesTrak provenance was used without network refresh or external verification.
The five encounters are a deterministic convenience sample, not a representative corpus.
Near-zero differences in this sample do not validate SGP4/two-body equivalence generally.
No covariance/HBR-backed Foster Pc before/after calculation was performed; no collision-risk reduction or operational safety claim follows.
